download_files_from_hub: download files or entire repositories from the Hugging Face Hub with optional filters and revisions
upload_files_to_hub: upload files or folders to a Hugging Face Hub repository with include/exclude patterns and commit options
upload_large_folder_to_hub: upload a large folder to the Hub with resumable uploads and configurable workers
manage_authentication_tokens: manage authentication tokens by logging in, logging out, switching between tokens, and listing stored tokens
print_environment_and_version: print environment information and the current huggingface_hub CLI version
